name: Cleatvarn
text: Mooring bollard. Make it fast and any boat within its reach is held at the quay: it cannot drift or be paddled away. Use it bare-handed to let go, or give it a redstone signal. Its reach grows with the harbour office. Age III.

name: Quaymorrek
text: Harbour office. A quay station that grows with the Age without any input: timber, then brick, iron and steel. Each stage widens the reach of every mooring bollard within 16 blocks (3 blocks, then 5, 7 and 9) and lets a boat there carry more cargo crates. Use it to read its stage. Age III.

name: Holdvarn
text: Cargo crate. Use it on a boat to fit a row of nine hold slots; sneak and use the boat with an empty hand to open the hold. A boat carries one crate, or more with a harbour office nearby (two, then one more for each stage). Crates and contents drop if the boat is destroyed. Age III.
